title: "Data Loader"

## Load World Bank Data Connection

```{python}
from helpers import create_database_engine, run_sql_and_return_df, run_sql_and_return_html, create_db_wrapper, execute_ddl

# Database connection using environment variable keys (mapped in .env file)
config_map = {
    'user': "CMSC408_HW8_USER",
    'password': "CMSC408_HW8_PASSWORD",
    'host': "CMSC408_HW8_HOST",
    'database': "CMSC408_HW8_DB_NAME"
}

# Create connection
cnx, config = create_db_wrapper(config_map)
```

## Confirm Available Tables

```{python}
run_sql_and_return_html(cnx, """
SELECT table_schema, table_name, table_rows
FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE table_schema = 'world_bank_data';
""")
```

## Preview Key Table (Optional)

```{python}
run_sql_and_return_html(cnx, """
SELECT *
FROM world_bank_data.wdi_country
LIMIT 10;
""")
```

## If Needed: Refresh wdi_country Table Copy

```{python}
execute_ddl(cnx, """
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS wdi_country;
""")

execute_ddl(cnx, """
CREATE TABLE wdi_country AS
SELECT * FROM world_bank_data.wdi_country
WHERE is_country = 1;
""")
```

```{python}
run_sql_and_return_html(cnx, """
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wdi_country;
""")
